I implemented the C++20 CLI in [output/main.cpp](/workspace/output/main.cpp) with its build file at [output/CMakeLists.txt](/workspace/output/CMakeLists.txt). It accepts the requested flags, writes a `.bbl` or error JSON to `--output`, and writes the optional structured log.

It builds with `cmake -S output -B build && cmake --build build`. A smoke test with `plain.bst` produced a formatted entry.

**BibTeX 0.99c parity is not verified.** The implementation is incomplete for byte exact replacement, including the exact `width$` table and full author-name and special-character behavior. I would not swap it into a production LaTeX workflow expecting identical PDFs.
